failure_category.description:
Why Flint could not calculate the method and the action that can make calculation succeed.
- `dependency_failure`: Retry after the dependent service recovers.
- `timeout`: Retry after the timed-out dependency recovers.
- `malformed_response`: Fix the callback response so it matches the documented response schema, then retry.
- `callback_transport_failure`: Restore callback DNS, TLS, network connectivity, and response timing, then retry.
- `callback_result_invalid`: Fix the callback result fields or values identified by the callback logs, then retry.
- `pricing_failure`: Fix the method pricing configuration or matching rate, then retry.
- `schedule_failure`: Fix the method schedule, timezone, or requested window, then retry.
- `geography_failure`: Fix the destination, origin, or geographic configuration, then retry.
- `routing_failure`: Fix inventory routing or origin assignment, then retry.
- `address_verification_failed`: Correct the address fields rejected by verification, then retry.
- `address_could_not_be_verified`: Confirm or correct the address, or retry when address verification is available.

unavailable_reason.description:
Why the method is unavailable and the action that can make it eligible.
- `destination_not_served`: Use a destination covered by this method or choose another method.
- `pickup_unavailable`: Choose an available pickup method or location.
- `no_window_available`: Choose another offered window or a method with availability for the requested time.
- `eligibility_no_match`: Inspect eligibility_mismatches, then change the relevant buyer facts or method eligibility rule.
- `pricing_unavailable`: Add or activate a matching rate, or provide the required caller-supplied price.
- `inventory_unavailable`: Choose an origin or method backed by available inventory.

failure_category.description:
Why Flint could not calculate the method and the action that can make calculation succeed.
- `dependency_failure`: Retry after the dependent service recovers.
- `timeout`: Retry after the timed-out dependency recovers.
- `malformed_response`: Fix the callback response so it matches the documented response schema, then retry.
- `callback_transport_failure`: Restore callback DNS, TLS, network connectivity, and response timing, then retry.
- `callback_circuit_open`: Restore the callback and wait for circuit recovery before retrying.
- `callback_result_invalid`: Fix the callback result fields or values identified by the callback logs, then retry.
- `callback_unavailable`: Restore the configured callback endpoint or choose a non-callback pricing strategy.
- `pricing_failure`: Fix the method pricing configuration or matching rate, then retry.
- `schedule_failure`: Fix the method schedule, timezone, or requested window, then retry.
- `option_lifetime_too_short`: Increase the method minimum option lifetime or return a later callback expiry.
- `geography_failure`: Fix the destination, origin, or geographic configuration, then retry.
- `routing_failure`: Fix inventory routing or origin assignment, then retry.
- `invalid_configuration`: Correct the invalid delivery configuration identified by diagnostics, then retry.
- `invalid_buyer_input`: Correct the buyer input identified by the outcome, then retry.
- `address_verification_failed`: Correct the address fields rejected by verification, then retry.
- `address_could_not_be_verified`: Confirm or correct the address, or retry when address verification is available.

unavailable_reason.description:
Why the method is unavailable and the action that can make it eligible.
- `destination_not_served`: Use a destination covered by this method or choose another method.
- `pickup_unavailable`: Choose an available pickup method or location.
- `no_window_available`: Choose another offered window or a method with availability for the requested time.
- `eligibility_no_match`: Inspect eligibility_mismatches, then change the relevant buyer facts or method eligibility rule.
- `method_type_not_allowed`: Choose a method type allowed by every line item in the choice group.
- `pricing_unavailable`: Add or activate a matching rate, or provide the required caller-supplied price.
- `inventory_unavailable`: Choose an origin or method backed by available inventory.

failure_category.description:
Why the callback test failed and the action that can make the next test succeed.
- `blocked_target`: Use a public HTTPS callback target allowed by Flint's outbound network policy.
- `connection_error`: Restore network connectivity to the callback host, then test again.
- `dns_error`: Fix the callback hostname or its DNS records, then test again.
- `invalid_response`: Return the documented callback response status, headers, and JSON body, then test again.
- `request_error`: Fix the callback request handling identified by the test result, then test again.
- `timeout`: Acknowledge the callback within its configured timeout, then test again.
- `tls_error`: Fix the callback certificate and TLS configuration, then test again.

status.description:

- `pending`: Work has not started. Start, schedule, accept, hold, cancel, or fail it as supported_actions allows.
- `in_progress`: Work has started and is not yet ready or complete.
- `ready`: The fulfillment is ready for pickup, handoff, or completion.
- `completed`: All fulfillment work completed successfully.
- `canceled`: The fulfillment was intentionally canceled and will not continue.
- `failed`: The fulfillment could not be completed. Resolve the recorded reason before creating replacement work.
- `scheduled`: The fulfillment is scheduled for its recorded service window.
- `preparing`: Warehouse or provider preparation is underway.
- `picked`: The assigned items have been picked.
- `packed`: The assigned items have been packed.
- `dispatched`: The fulfillment left its origin for delivery or handoff.

- `out_for_delivery`: The shipment is on its final delivery route.
- `delivered`: The carrier reported successful delivery.
- `delivery_attempted`: The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery.
- `exception`: A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue.
- `returned`: The shipment was returned toward or to its origin.
- `voided`: The shipment was voided and will not continue through delivery.

status.description:
Public work status. Fulfillments with request_status accepted project to status pending. Fulfillments with outcome.outcome_type no_show project to status failed. A fulfillment with active_hold projects to its public work status from before the hold.
- `pending`: Work has not started. Start, schedule, accept, hold, cancel, or fail it as supported_actions allows.
- `in_progress`: Work has started and is not yet ready or complete.
- `ready`: The fulfillment is ready for pickup, handoff, or completion.
- `completed`: All fulfillment work completed successfully.
- `canceled`: The fulfillment was intentionally canceled and will not continue.
- `failed`: The fulfillment could not be completed. Resolve the recorded reason before creating replacement work.
- `scheduled`: The fulfillment is scheduled for its recorded service window.
- `preparing`: Warehouse or provider preparation is underway.
- `picked`: The assigned items have been picked.
- `packed`: The assigned items have been packed.
- `dispatched`: The fulfillment left its origin for delivery or handoff.

When code is PROMOTION_DECLINED, branch on reason. Promotion decline reasons are: not_eligible, minimum_not_met, expired, not_yet_started, exhausted, code_required, code_invalid, disabled, automatic_disabled, codes_disabled, already_applied, not_combinable, superseded_by_better_offer, superseded, max_promotions_reached, no_discountable_balance, buy_item_missing, currency_mismatch, unknown_type.

requested_key_mode.description: API key mode requested for the rejected scope grant.

required_money.description: Money amount required to satisfy a minimum threshold, when the error is threshold-based.

amount.description: Amount in the currency's minor unit, such as cents for USD.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this amount.

scope.description: Canonical public scope rejected by validation, when the detail concerns one scope.

shortage_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

status.description:
Public work status. Fulfillments with request_status accepted project to status pending. Fulfillments with outcome.outcome_type no_show project to status failed. A fulfillment with active_hold projects to its public work status from before the hold.
- `pending`: Work has not started. Start, schedule, accept, hold, cancel, or fail it as supported_actions allows.
- `in_progress`: Work has started and is not yet ready or complete.
- `ready`: The fulfillment is ready for pickup, handoff, or completion.
- `completed`: All fulfillment work completed successfully.
- `canceled`: The fulfillment was intentionally canceled and will not continue.
- `failed`: The fulfillment could not be completed. Resolve the recorded reason before creating replacement work.
- `scheduled`: The fulfillment is scheduled for its recorded service window.
- `preparing`: Warehouse or provider preparation is underway.
- `picked`: The assigned items have been picked.
- `packed`: The assigned items have been packed.
- `dispatched`: The fulfillment left its origin for delivery or handoff.

Read-only shipment state derived from the shipment's package states. An empty shipment remains a created draft.
- `created`: The shipment leg exists but has not been packed or handed off.
- `packed`: The shipment leg is packed and awaiting carrier handoff.
- `shipped`: The shipment leg was handed to the carrier.
- `in_transit`: The carrier is moving the shipment through its network.
- `out_for_delivery`: The shipment is on its final delivery route.
- `delivered`: The carrier reported successful delivery.
- `delivery_attempted`: The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery.
- `exception`: A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue.
- `returned`: The shipment was returned toward or to its origin.
- `voided`: The shipment was voided and will not continue through delivery.

status.description:
Current package lifecycle state. Package states are the source used to derive shipment status.
- `created`: The package record exists but has not been packed or handed off.
- `packed`: The package is packed and awaiting carrier handoff.
- `shipped`: The package was handed to the carrier.
- `in_transit`: The carrier is moving the package through its network.
- `out_for_delivery`: The package is on its final delivery route.
- `delivered`: The carrier reported successful delivery.
- `delivery_attempted`: The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery.
- `exception`: A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue.
- `returned`: The package was returned toward or to its origin.
- `voided`: The package was voided and will not continue through delivery.

allocation.description: How the effect is applied across the matched items or charges. each applies the effect to every matched item independently: a fixed amount_off is charged per item (10 USD off 3 items discounts 30 USD, each capped at the item price), and a percent_off is taken from each item. across applies the effect once to the matched set as a whole: a fixed amount_off is the whole amount one time (10 USD off the group total, not prorated per item), and a percent_off is taken from the combined subtotal. For percent_off the two produce the same total and differ only in how the discount is attributed to individual line items; for amount_off they differ by the number of matched items, so set it deliberately. Defaults to each for line_item and service_charge promotions and across for order promotions. max_discounted_quantity requires each.

- `pending`: Work has not started. Start, schedule, accept, hold, cancel, or fail it as supported_actions allows.
- `in_progress`: Work has started and is not yet ready or complete.
- `ready`: The fulfillment is ready for pickup, handoff, or completion.
- `completed`: All fulfillment work completed successfully.
- `canceled`: The fulfillment was intentionally canceled and will not continue.
- `failed`: The fulfillment could not be completed. Resolve the recorded reason before creating replacement work.
- `scheduled`: The fulfillment is scheduled for its recorded service window.
- `preparing`: Warehouse or provider preparation is underway.
- `picked`: The assigned items have been picked.
- `packed`: The assigned items have been packed.
- `dispatched`: The fulfillment left its origin for delivery or handoff.

approved_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Approved quantity ranges from zero through the return line's requested_quantity. Declining any requested quantity requires decline_reason; decline context is invalid when all requested quantity is approved.

decision_basis.description: Which decision semantics this line uses. With policy_evaluation you accept the recorded policy proposal and send only approved_quantity plus decline context; the explicit fields are rejected. With explicit you state the outcome yourself and return_required_quantity is required, and approving any quantity also requires allowed_resolution_types and resolution_mode. A resolution_mode of automatic additionally requires selected_resolution_type, and any return_required_quantity above 0 additionally requires a receiving_location_id whose Location has a postal address.

status.description:
Read-only shipment state derived from the shipment's package states. An empty shipment remains a created draft.
- `created`: The shipment leg exists but has not been packed or handed off.
- `packed`: The shipment leg is packed and awaiting carrier handoff.
- `shipped`: The shipment leg was handed to the carrier.
- `in_transit`: The carrier is moving the shipment through its network.
- `out_for_delivery`: The shipment is on its final delivery route.
- `delivered`: The carrier reported successful delivery.
- `delivery_attempted`: The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery.
- `exception`: A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue.
- `returned`: The shipment was returned toward or to its origin.
- `voided`: The shipment was voided and will not continue through delivery.

The all and any arrays contain rules or nested rule groups. There is no rules key. Sending a rules key, an unexpected key, or both all and any is rejected with INVALID_RULE_GROUP.

attribute.description: Field the rule tests. The attribute fixes the value type and the operators that are legal for it: money attributes accept comparison operators but not eq or in, booleans accept eq only, and so on. The full attribute/type/operator matrix is machine-readable in x-flint-rule-attributes on this schema. metadata.<key> reads a string from the customer's metadata and accepts the string operators. A disallowed operator is rejected at create time with INVALID_OPERATOR, whose message names the operators allowed for the attribute.
